title: Decode sweep
spec: Add src/recorder/sweep.ts: decodeSweep(messages) → { frames: by type, malformed: { seq, reason }[], unverified: number, nonTclk: number }. A line that starts with "tclk1 " but fails decodeFrame is malformed with the thrown reason; a frame whose `from` differs from the message sender or that lacks a sig is unverified; everything else is nonTclk. Never throws.
